title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.302 - Fixed structured output results delivering a response's output as `structured_output` when the API refused that response; the result is now an error with no payload - Changed an omitted `permissionMode` to start in `default` mode on third-party providers, with telemetry off or on a fresh install; pass `permissionMode: 'auto'` to keep auto mode - Changed fork subagents (`subagent_type: "fork"`) to be on by default in SDK sessions, as in the terminal; `run_in_background` is still offered, and `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` turns them off - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.302 ## 0.3.301 - Added per-tool permission policies to sdk-type MCP server configs: `tools` entries with `permission_policy` `always_ask` or `always_deny`, applied on `initialize` and `setMcpServers()` - Added `BUILTIN_TOOL_NAMES` and `LEGACY_TOOL_NAME_ALIASES` exports: the public built-in tool names and their earlier names, for checking permission rules and tool settings - Added `addPlugins` to `Query.reloadPlugins()` so a host can load more plugin folders into a running session
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
